justification: Visible equal_projection example shows two states with same value but different tags. FDHT projection discipline requires distinguishing projected equality from full-state equality.
Visible partition example shows independent states with different values. FDHT does not treat temporary divergence as failure.
Visible merge takes maximum value. Order may not affect consumer-visible output.
Visible spec does not state whether merge_count has consumer significance. FDHT cannot determine from visible information alone.
FDHT distinguishes history from state. Visible merge produces equivalent states from different paths. History identity may not be required for consumer.
